simulation_contract.discordance_definition: Probability that full and path-insensitive predictions differ among gold-positive eligible obligations
mdi_outputs: Claimable MDI including probability of minimum-positive eligibility
simulation_contract.negative_prediction_difference: None in the planning simulation; modeled gains arise only from positive-obligation sensitivity
simulation_contract.null_calibration: Empirical 97.5th percentile of eligible clustered null macro-F1 differences
simulation_contract.unknown_treatment: Absorbed as incorrect effective predictions and receives no power credit

summary.non_reached_interpretation: The preregistered design does not expand. If actual minimum-positive guards fail, confirmatory superiority and sensitivity claims are withheld.
